They equal elsewhere_not_rebuilt in the SHADOW records and the driver's counters.nonfinite_step_failures. No Y line carries driver code E, and problem.rs:660 (eval_rhs_into) rejects a non-finite RHS, so the driver attempted no linear solve at those stages and K and V are unaffected. findings.correction: K and V stand. Next to K and V, state that 69 attempt-ending stages in cusp1d had a non-finite RHS, so there was nothing to replay. They are counted apart under the pinned target code, not as rebuild failures.
